platform: Cloud-based browser ERP with native Android and iOS apps; no desktop client or on-premise edition documented.

distinctive_features.feature: Admission CRM with configurable stages, lead assignment, weighted entrance evaluation, document validation, and payment reconciliation.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: It supports a detailed enquiry-to-enrolment process, including applicant evaluation and follow-up.

distinctive_features.feature: Alexa voice access to homework, attendance, school news, circulars, and fee dues.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Families can retrieve common school information hands-free through a voice interface.
It provides an online proctoring option, though public technical details are limited.

distinctive_features.feature: Vendor claims more than 1,100 report-card formats and supports CBSE, CISCE, IB, and IGCSE workflows.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can tailor reporting to different boards and local assessment formats.

distinctive_features.feature: Bus tracking and attendance through an Android phone carried on each bus.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can provide live location and route attendance without dedicated GPS hardware.

distinctive_features.feature: Separate parent, teacher, management, alumni, safety, and transport app experiences.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Role-specific apps expose different functions to families, staff, management, and transport users.

distinctive_features.feature: Task workflow with overdue alerts and escalation to higher management.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Escalation can make overdue staff tasks and service requests more visible to managers.

weaknesses.issue: Pricing is quote-only, with no published tiers or implementation amounts.
Reviews report lag and slow data loading.
Review synthesis cites complex module views and slow implementation.
App reviews cite erratic notifications, stale unread status, and broken leave date-picker behavior.
Some reviewers report slow issue resolution or support hand-offs.
Public materials do not document an open API or OneRoster, LTI, or Ed-Fi support.
Google Play data-safety declarations say data is not encrypted and cannot be deleted, conflicting with vendor security claims.
Public documentation does not establish UDISE+ submission, APAAR integration, or GST invoicing.

ai_features: AI-based online exam proctoring through PowerTEST.
Alexa voice skills for homework, attendance, circulars, news, and fee dues.
No generative AI assistant or predictive-risk model documented.
pricing_model_summary: No public price list; quote-based subscription with one-time implementation and training charges, billed monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly by agreement.
biggest_strategic_gap: Limited documented interoperability: no open API or major education data standards, alongside unclear statutory integrations and inconsistent public app data-safety declarations.
